serviceIdentification.serviceDescription: GetEkko is delivered as a Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) offering using a multi-tenant public cloud computing provider that allows GetEkko to create dedicated customer environments for data isolation and segmentation. It is available to customers that require identity-proofing in conjunction with secure transmission of messages without the ability to read the payload in transit to users within groups, based upon schedules, or availability within the central platform.
